brief_title: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of a Supplement on Appetite, Gut Health, and Blood Sugar
official_title: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of a Supplement on Appetite, Gut Health, and Blood Sugar

arm_groups.label: Etta Vita GLP-1 Supplement
intervention_names: Dietary Supplement: Etta Vita GLP-1 Supplement Intervention

primary_outcomes.measure: Change in Blood Glucose via blood test
Change in HbA1c via blood test
Change in Leptin via blood test
Change in Appetite via self-reported questionnaire

brief_summary:
This study evaluates the effects of the Etta Vita GLP-1 supplement on appetite, gut health, and blood sugar over a 12-week period. Thirty participants with a BMI of 25 or greater and experiencing at least two of the following issues - food cravings, poor appetite control, irregular bowel movements, bloating, or gut issues - will use the test product daily.

The trial is a single-arm, open-label study in which all participants take two capsules of the supplement each morning, no more than 15 minutes before their first meal. Participants complete questionnaires at Baseline, Week 4, Week 8, and Week 12, and attend their local clinic for blood tests (HbA1c, Glucose, and Leptin) at Baseline and Week 12.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Be male or female
* BMI greater than or equal to 25
* Be aged 21-60
* Anyone experiencing issues regarding any two of the following over the past four weeks: food cravings, poor appetite control, irregular bowel movements, bloating, or gut issues
* If taking any products, prescription medications, or supplements that target appetite, blood sugar, and gut health, has been doing so consistently for at least three months, and is willing to maintain this routine for the duration of the test period
* Anyone willing to maintain their current sleep schedule and activity level for the duration of the study
* Anyone who considers themselves in good general health
* Resides in the United States

Exclusion Criteria:

* Anyone with any chronic health conditions that could impact participation in this study, such as cancer, mental health disorders, history of serious illness in the last three months, history of substance abuse, or planned surgery during the study period
* Anyone who drinks heavily (i.e. 8 or more alcoholic drinks per week for women or 15 or more alcoholic drinks per week for men)
* Anyone with a known history of severe digestive disorders like acid reflux, Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS), Irritable Bowel Disease (IBD), ulcerative colitis (UC), celiac disease, Crohn's disease, or gastrointestinal tract surgeries
* Anyone currently taking GLP-1 receptor agonist medications
* Any women who are pregnant, breastfeeding, or trying to conceive (or who will be at any point during the study period)
* Anyone diagnosed with renal or hepatic disease
* Anyone diagnosed with type 1 or type 2 diabetes
* Anyone unwilling to follow the study protocol
* Currently partaking in another research study or will be partaking in any other research study at any point during this study's duration
